capabilities: Builds a guided lesson plan from chosen notes and walks through one concept at a time
Grades written quiz answers by meaning and records a confidence level for each
Runs timed multiple-choice challenges with 20 seconds per question
Turns missed questions and lesson key points into FSRS-scheduled review cards
Saves a Markdown lesson summary with links to the source notes
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux). Selected note text and answers are sent through Claude Code to Anthropic's servers when a session starts; no telemetry and no plugin server. Progress is stored in the plugin's data.json. Interface in English and French. Independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic.
problem: Notes stay passive reading material, with no built-in way to be taught from them, quizzed on them, or to have weak points rescheduled for review.

relations.evidence: It runs Claude Code, Anthropic's command-line tool, already installed on your computer.
scheduled with FSRS (the algorithm used by Anki)

requires.name: Paid Claude plan or Claude Console usage billing

summary: Tutor that turns selected notes into guided lessons, written quizzes, timed challenges and FSRS-scheduled review cards.
